reviews.author: Calvin Harrington
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! Had an emergency with my mother’s minivan leaking coolant after an accident they jumped right on it even tacked her bumper up so she could drive it safely definitely WILL be back!

reviews.author: Theresa Dees
reviews.text: Shout out to Brandon and Jordan for getting the unwanted passenger out of my jeep...Apologies for it running into the shop!

reviews.author: Sophie Kaplan
reviews.text: I wish I could give them more stars!!!! Came in with my front bumper looking like it was about to fall off. They fixed it in place and I was on my way in around 15 minutes. I was so thankful but they didn't want to accept any payment since I had just asked for a temporary patch up. Awesome team and friendliness.

reviews.author: Yesenia Mitzner
reviews.text: We had a wheel bearing issue on a Saturday, turns out most places are closed on Saturday but these guys were willing to look at my van and fix the issue right away. I’m impressed with the service and professionalism they provided. I’m very grateful that they helped me fast. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: James Stroud
reviews.text: Landon was awesome. He beat the quote price of a major chain, did quality work, and was honest and thorough. I will definitely be using him again! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: James Wellman
reviews.text: New a of 10/05/2022 Ok I'm giving/leaving my post at 5 stars! They do great work everything seems to be hooked back up correctly, no dings, scratches or dents in body, they notified me of problems that would be wise to go ahead and replace now so I did not get charged for labor again, like the water pump, accessorie belts, outer and inner passenger tie rods, and power steering boot. They held off on the valve cover gaskets, spark plugs, cam seals, crank seals(reason=entire top of engine has to come off along with all vacuum lines[night mare] You will never find a price that is this good..... Just for the belt and labor Mazda wanted A friend of mine told me these guys do great work, as for me I usually stick with the dealership for find work on my cars, so I'm going to give these guys a shot a replacing the timing belt, all the idler pullys, crank seal, cam seals, water pump, both valve cover gaskets, and oil change on my 2002 Mazda Millenia S 2.3l supercharged turbocharged Miller cycle engine. Quoted me just under a thousand dollars. We will see how it goes, and I pray I did not pick the wrong time to stop using the dealership. I've always used small businesses except when it comes to car repairs. I really hope these guys prove me wrong. Will keep you updated as the job progresses. If they are as good as I'm told I might have them drop the new 4.0lv6 into my explorer

reviews.author: Bullseye Hvac
reviews.text: Did a great job on a ls swap on a obs truck for me. Prices where great and service was even better. A++ will be using for future upgrades.

reviews.author: Catherine Stephens
reviews.text: Guys are awesome, they got me in and finished with two hours, last minute also definitely great shop to come Too. Will definitely refer others!

reviews.author: douglas varnadore
reviews.text: Great place to do business got me in and got my truck back on the road fast and at a good price !!!!
